content: Kooh na cuuɓiŋ ɗe Israayel
Ŋ niki ŋ nik ŋ Kiristaani, mi na woye keeh, ŋ leyɗi. Ŋ ineem, liiɓiŋ ngo huniɗ na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, te wa seede'iɗ to ini mi na hee woye wii :
Ŋ raakiɗ tiis keeh-keeh, te wa gen ndo misik ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ.
Nikeen ne ŋ kiim Kooh, a aluk ko, ŋ saɓsukoh na Kiristaani, wa heen tahe ɓaah ciŋ ngo muc ɗah, ŋ heena tume.

Ɓaah ciŋ ngo ɓeem, ɓeɗ Israayel ci. Ɓeɗ Kooh tum kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, niki a nik na ɓa ŋ yaki a yak, weɗ a baahoh ɓa, a ambtiɗohha na ɓa, a eɗta ɓa nakoh ciŋ waasi, a woosa ɓa findi ɓa ñaamkohan ɗe na in ci a gap ɓa,
caac ca maañiɗ ca ɓeɗ caac ciŋ ɓa, ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ faaniŋ Kiristaani, a ɓaah nga ɓa, Kiristaani yi nik ŋ ɗafuk in ci jen, a yi Kooh, te a yakɗaah po faw ! Amiin !
Wa nikɗi haa ne gapoh ciŋ Kooh nikisɗi. Laam ɓi puloh ŋ Israayel, wa nikɗi haa ne ɓa jen ɓa Israayel keeh-keeh.
Te ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima, ɓa jen ɓeɗ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe keeh-keeh haa ; waaye Kooh woo Ibrahiima ne : « Fu raakohan ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa ŋ Isaahha. »
Ineem tokis inii : A set ci Ibrahiima rimoot, ɓeɗ kuɓuuciŋ Kooh haa, waaye a kuɓuuci Kooh gapee ɗe ɓeɗ ambu findi ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe.
Inii weɗ gapohi Kooh gapee Ibrahiima : « Ŋ hey dokkisse ndii maas, ŋ raakan Saarata raakiɗ kuɓu ƴaar. »
Ɓaatta nga, a tumoh ɗaa na Rebeka, e siis ciŋ ɗe ɓeɗ ɓaahee baab yino, a nikka Isaahha, caac ɓoo.

Raak siis ceem rimuuɗi paaɗ, ɓa tumeeɗi baahiɗ wala baahaaɗi. Moona, Kooh woyeen Rebeka ne : « Yi ƴini hey yilfe yi yakki. » Findi Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyoha an : « Ŋ tan Yaŋhooɓa, ŋ faɗta Esaaw. » Ineem raakiɗ ne wa nikiɗ ini Kooh tufkiɗe. Kooh na tane ŋ findi a waaɗoh, wa gaƴukɗi ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓoyi, waaye, ŋ Kooh yi na ɓeeɗke ɓoyi.
Ɓoo woyan ye ŋ ineem nak ? Kooh yurahɗi e ? Muk ! Ineem minɗi nik !
A woo Musaa ne : « Ŋ hey yirme yi ŋ waaɗ yirim, te ŋ baahohee yi ŋ waaɗ baahoh. »
Mbaa, wa nikɗi ŋ ɓoyi na waaɗee wa wala yi na ndengɗuke nga, waaye ŋ Kooh, yi na yirmohe.
Ŋ Fiis ci, Kooh woo Firawna ne : « Ñam tufkiɗ ɗa ne ŋ min teeɓoh hatiliŋ ngo taamboh nga ɗa te tiikiŋ ngo wil kehƴi jen. »
Kon a yi na yirme yi a waaɗ yirim, a ndengɗee keeñiŋ yi a waaɗ ndengiɗ keeñiŋ ɗe.
Kooh a yi na tane findi a waaɗoh
Ŋ inhiɗ ne fu hey yo woye ne : « Nik ne ɓo' minɗi nookoh na waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh ɗah, kon wa ye tah Kooh ngaske ɓo' ? »
Waaye fu yi ɓo' dong, a fu ɓa po fu taastiɗohee na Kooh ? Andi ini mahu hey woye yi maha ne : « Wa ye tah fu mahohha so an ? »
Mahohi, andi waas onɗi ɗe ne a ɓay ŋ ɗokiŋ ɗe, a mah in kanak naa, wii njirñiɗkoha ŋ ceeke, wi tas njirñiɗkoha ŋ in ci ƴin ƴin ci ?
Moo ɓo' raak ye woyaah nga, nik ne Kooh muñɗee muñiɗ in maañiɗ ɓooɓi a ayruke, ɓi nikee ŋ kot sooƴ, sagu waaɗi a waaɗee teeɓoh ayrukiŋ ɗe na hatiliŋ ɗe ɗah.
Te a namee waaɗ teeɓoh yaki a yak keeh-keeh ŋ ɓooɓi misik ɗe ; ɓi a kooɗkiɗ ne ɓa ɓaah ŋ yaki a yak.
Ɓooɓeem, e ɓoo. A ɓeeɗkoh ɓoo ŋ ɗooƴ Yawuut ci dong haa, waaye ŋ ɓi namɗi nik Yawuut.

Mbaa ɓoo woyan ye ŋ ineem ? Ɓi nikɗi Yawuut waakeeɗi kiyurah, waaye ɓa rahsiɗa, ɓa rahasa taamboh ŋ kosi ɓa kos,
te Israayel ci waakee waasi min ɓa on kiyurah waaye ɓa raakɗaa.
